patches.name: Expressive Material 3 albums, artists & my tracks
patches.description: Extends the Material 3 Expressive design (fading hero covers, cover-adaptive & Monet palettes, 52dp pill buttons, connected secondary tiles, scroll-morphing toolbars, and clean collection headers) to Albums, Artists, My Tracks, My Albums, and My Artists.

options.title: Expressive Album pages
options.description: Apply the downward-fading hero cover, adaptive Monet colors, pill controls, and connected action bar to Album pages and My Albums.

options.title: Expressive Artist pages
options.description: Apply the downward-fading artist portrait hero, adaptive Monet colors, contributor chips, pill controls, and connected action bar to Artist pages and My Artists.

options.title: Expressive My Tracks screen
options.description: Apply Monet pill Play/Shuffle buttons, a tonal rounded Offline Download card, and clean track rows to My Tracks.

options.title: Expressive Collection tile grid
options.description: Redesigns the Collection screen category list into a Material 3 Expressive Bento tile grid with spring press animations and circular tonal top-bar buttons.

patches.name: Expressive Material 3 bottom sheets & menus
patches.description: Redesigns all TIDAL bottom sheets, track/media context menus, toolbar overflow & dropdown menus, and dialogs across XML Views and Jetpack Compose Material 3 with expressive corners, grouped menu cards, tonal icon badges, pill drag handles, and Monet surfaces.

options.title: Bottom sheet & menu corner style
options.description: Controls corner curvature for Material bottom sheets, popup/dropdown menus, and alert dialogs.

options.title: Segmented grouped context menu rows
options.description: Style track, album, playlist, and settings bottom-sheet menu items as M3 Expressive grouped tonal cards with circular icon badges.

options.title: Expressive overflow & dropdown menus
options.description: Apply 22dp rounded floating Monet containers, clean spacing, and pill ripples to AppCompat popup menus and Compose DropdownMenus.

options.title: Expressive Material 3 dialogs
options.description: Upgrade AlertDialogs and Compose AlertDialogs with 28dp Monet containers, crisp borders, and pill action buttons.

patches.name: Expressive Material 3 homepage
patches.description: Redesigns TIDAL's Homepage with Material 3 Expressive shortcut cards, rounded carousel artwork, Monet-styled Vibe chips and AppBar, unlocked pull-to-refresh, and promo decluttering.

options.title: Homepage cover & shortcut shape
options.description: Corner radius style for album/playlist carousel cards and quick-access shortcut cards.

options.title: Unlock homepage pull-to-refresh
options.description: Enables TIDAL's native Material pull-to-refresh gesture on the Homepage feed.

options.title: Hide Headliners upload banner
options.description: Hides the top creator upload promotional banner on the Homepage.

options.title: Hide promo modules
options.description: Hides promotional banners injected between Homepage music carousels.

options.title: Hide merch store modules
options.description: Hides merchandising shopping carousels from the Homepage.

patches.name: Expressive Material 3 playlist screen
patches.description: Redesigns TIDAL's Playlist screen in Material 3 Expressive style with a full-bleed downward-fading cover, cover-adaptive + Monet colors, pill Play/Shuffle buttons, connected action tiles, scroll-morphing toolbar, and polished track rows.

options.title: Playlist accent palette
options.description: Use colors extracted dynamically from each playlist cover or strictly follow your system Monet wallpaper.

options.title: Full-bleed downward-fading hero cover
options.description: Display playlist artwork edge-to-edge at the top with a smooth downward fade into the surface canvas.

options.title: Material 3 Expressive track rows
options.description: Round track artwork corners (12dp), add pill ripples, and preserve TIDAL's default active-track highlight.

patches.name: Expressive Material 3 search
patches.description: Redesigns TIDAL's Search & Explore landing page, default UnifiedSearchView, and refactored Compose Search screen with stadium-pill Monet search bars, frosted sticky glass headers, expressive filter pills, suggestion badges, and Monet-harmonized genre/tag cards.

options.title: Search bar corner shape
options.description: Controls the corner style for the Search bar across Search Landing, Active Search, and Compose Search.

options.title: Expressive Genre & Explore cards
options.description: Style Browse/Explore genre tiles, cloud pill tags, and navigation rows as tonal Material 3 Expressive cards.

options.title: Frosted glass Search header blur
options.description: Float scrolling Explore and Search results beneath a frosted GPU-blurred header backdrop (API 31+).

patches.name: Linn Majik DSM Wi-Fi playback
patches.description: Discovers Linn DS/DSM speakers (OpenHome) on the local Wi-Fi in TIDAL's Devices sheet and streams Lossless / Hi-Res FLAC playback with full transport, queue, hardware volume, and lockscreen controls.

options.title: Preferred audio quality
options.description: Audio quality streamed to Linn Majik DSM over Wi-Fi (Hi-Res remuxes 24-bit/192 kHz DASH FLAC losslessly into native FLAC).

options.title: Stream delivery mode
options.description: Local HTTP Proxy guarantees compatibility across all Linn DSM/1-5 generations and enables bit-perfect 24-bit/192 kHz DASH FLAC remuxing.

options.title: Auto-wake standby & switch input
options.description: Automatically wakes the Linn Majik DSM from standby and switches its active source to Playlist when selected in TIDAL.

options.title: Manual Linn DSM IP (optional fallback)
options.description: Optional LAN IP address (e.g. 192.168.1.50 or 192.168.1.50:55178) if SSDP multicast discovery is blocked on your Wi-Fi network.

patches.name: Material 3 Expressive full player
patches.description: Replaces TIDAL's Now Playing screen with a Material 3 Expressive player featuring a heavily blurred cover backdrop, connected split pills, squiggly animated seekbar, morphing transport shapes, full-screen animated lyrics, and an expressive Play Queue.

options.title: Player blurred background style
options.description: How the heavily blurred cover backdrop and tonal accents are rendered.

options.title: Swipe cover art to skip tracks
options.description: Swipe the album artwork horizontally with spring tilt physics to skip to next or previous track.

options.title: Expressive wavy seekbar
options.description: Animate the active playback track with a Material 3 Expressive sine wave while playing.

options.title: Expressive Material 3 Play Queue
options.description: Redesigns the Play Queue and Suggested Tracks modal with cover-adaptive tonal scrims, segmented pill tabs, spotlight active card, and expressive track cards.

patches.name: Material 3 Expressive navbar & mini-player
patches.description: Replaces TIDAL's bottom bar and mini-player with a Material 3 Expressive split-pill floating navbar (with detached search button) and a separate floating mini-player card.

options.title: Navbar & mini-player color style
options.description: Material You surface palette style for the floating navbar and mini-player.

options.title: Keep 3 core tabs in pill
options.description: Shows Home, Explore, and Library in the left pill and Search in the right circle (hiding the Uploads tab).

options.title: Swipe mini-player gestures
options.description: Swipe the floating mini-player left/right to skip or go back with morphing preview pills, and pull up to interactively expand the full-screen player.

options.title: Progressive blur under navigation bar
options.description: Replaces the solid bottom color fade behind the floating navigation bar and mini-player with a live multi-tier GPU progressive blur and frosted glass pills.

patches.name: Material You dynamic theme
patches.description: Remaps TIDAL's hardcoded cyan accents, Market colors, dark zinc surfaces, and corner shapes across Wave 1, Wave 2, and Square Market to Android Material 3 Expressive Monet tokens.

options.title: AMOLED pure black background
options.description: Keep pure #000000 background instead of tonal Material You base surface while still dynamically tinting accents and elevated cards.

options.title: Monet palette intensity
options.description: Controls how strongly wallpaper Monet chroma tints app surfaces and cards.

options.title: Material 3 Expressive rounded shapes
options.description: Upgrades Square Market and Wave 1/Wave 2 corner radii to rounder Material 3 Expressive squircle/pill geometry.

options.title: Expressive GPU blur & frosted glass
options.description: Enables hardware-accelerated RenderEffect & cross-window blur across hero artwork fading, sticky toolbars, bottom sheets, popup menus, and dialogs (API 31+).

options.title: Blur intensity
options.description: Controls the blur radius multiplier applied to progressive blur fades and frosted glass surfaces.

patches.name: System Light & Dark theme
patches.description: Adds a Material 3 Expressive Monet Light (White) Mode and switches TIDAL automatically between Light and Dark themes based on your Android system setting (or forces Light/Dark), adapting all Compose surfaces, icons, text contrast, dialogs, and system bars.

options.title: App theme mode
options.description: Automatically switch TIDAL between Material You Light (White) and Dark Mode following Android system settings, or lock to Light or Dark.

patches.name: Track swipe gestures
patches.description: Adds Material 3 Expressive swipe gestures to track rows (queue, play next, favorite, add to playlist).

options.title: Swipe right action
options.description: Action triggered when swiping a track row to the right.

options.title: Swipe left action
options.description: Action triggered when swiping a track row to the left.

options.title: Haptic feedback
options.description: Vibrate subtly when crossing the swipe threshold and triggering an action.

options.title: Swipe threshold (dp)
options.description: Horizontal drag distance in dp required to trigger a swipe action (36–160).
